description: Tom Sell, candidate for Congress in Texas’ 19th Congressional District, expressed sincere gratitude for the endorsement of the Texas Farm Bureau AGFUND, the state’s largest grassroots organization — representing more than 480,000 member families including the farm and ranch families that embody America’s first and most foundational industry.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Conservative Tom Sell for Congress
title: Tom Sell Endorsed by Texas Farm Bureau AGFUND | Conservative Tom Sell for Congress
